verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents a Raise disputes API for filing disputes on behalf of cardholders and a Dispute webhook type for tracking status. Supporting evidence, however, is only described as a zip file uploaded through the Customer Area as a pilot feature, not as a programmatic submission. Missing for 10: network reason code handling, programmatic evidence submission via API, provisional credit handling, detail on webhook status lifecycle through resolution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
